Vizard vs VEXI: AI Clipper or Your Whole Social Media?
Vizard turns long videos into short clips and schedules them. VEXI also starts from a photo, a link or nothing, and designs posts and carousels.
Vizard is an AI clipper for long recordings, with a scheduler. Here is how it compares with one app that makes and posts your whole feed.

Vizard is an AI video clipper. It turns long videos, such as podcasts and webinars, into short clips for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts, with AI captions, AI B-roll and an editor that trims a clip when you delete words from its transcript. It also writes social captions and hashtags, and its Creator and Business plans schedule posts and publish directly to social media. There is a no-cost plan with 60 credits a month, where one credit is one minute of video; paid plans are sold by credits.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Credit where it is due: Vizard is quick at finding the best moments in a long recording, and it posts them. The difference is where you start, and what else goes out. Vizard needs a long video to clip, and every format it makes is a video. VEXI starts from a photo, a clip, a link or nothing at all, also designs posts and carousels, and Autopilot runs your week ahead. VEXI costs more than Vizard: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Vizard clips the recordings you upload. Without a long video to start from, there is nothing for it to clip.
VEXI starts from a photo, a clip, a link, or nothing at all: describe what you want and it makes the post.
Every format on its pages is a video clip. It makes no designed posts or carousels.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
You Pick And Slot Every Clip
You choose the clips and set the schedule. Its pages describe no mode that plans and posts the week for you.
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.

VEXI turns a long recording into its best clips too, and starts from a photo, a link or nothing at all.
Does Vizard post to social media?

Yes. Its Creator and Business plans schedule posts and publish directly to social media; you choose the clips and the times. VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile, on a schedule or on Autopilot.

There is a no-cost plan with 60 credits a month, where one credit is one minute of video. Creator and Business are sold by credits. Their prices did not show on its pricing page when we read it, so check that page before you buy.
What do Trustpilot reviewers say about Vizard?
Vizard is rated 4.7 on Trustpilot. Some reviewers report unused credits lost on cancelling with no refund, a no-cost plan that felt less free than advertised, and slow support replies.
